title: P0: Set a non-default click type on a click step updates the row label to "Right click"
verifies: the click-type picker appears on a fresh click step and selecting right updates the row label badge to "Right click"

title: P0: Convert a click step to a hover step hides the click-type picker and shows the locator block without a value input
verifies: choosing hover hides the click-type picker, renders the locator block, and shows no value input

title: P1: Each click type maps to its correct row label (double, middle, left)
verifies: double/middle update the row label to "Double click"/"Middle click" and left returns the badge to plain "Click"

title: P1: The action picker offers hover and omits retired actions
verifies: the action picker lists hover and filters out scroll/wait/screenshot

title: P1: Leaving click clears click metadata so returning to click shows a plain "Click"
verifies: switching away from click discards button/click_count so returning shows the default "Click" label

title: P1: A journey with a right-click and a hover step saves successfully
verifies: a journey containing button:right and a hover action passes save validation and persists

title: P2: A hover step without a locator blocks the journey with a locator-required error
verifies: a hover step missing a locator candidate is rejected at the journey step with the locator-required error

title: P2: A hand-added step action change shows no discard notice
verifies: changing a hand-added step's action does not render the recorded-payload-discarded notice
